title: Agentic AI in government just hit the hard part: deciding what a machine may decide
summary: The UAE has been a pioneer in AI adoption since 2017, establishing the world's first minister of state for AI. The article explores the emerging challenge of classifying and defining the boundaries of what autonomous AI systems can and cannot decide in government contexts, which represents the most difficult aspect of implementing agentic AI in public sector operations.
problem_solved: Addresses the critical challenge of defining decision-making authority boundaries for autonomous AI systems in government operations.
why_valuable: Provides early insights into how leading nations are navigating the complex governance questions around AI autonomy, serving as a model for other governments facing similar decisions.
